title: Participles — every tense and voice, fully declined

paradigms.label: παιδεύων — Present Active Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: Verbal adjective: -οντ- masculine/neuter (like γέρων), short-α feminine (like μοῦσα). Accent is persistent from παιδεύων.

paradigms.label: παιδεύων — Present Active Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Masculine/neuter dative plural παιδεύουσι(ν) is spelled exactly like a 3rd person plural verb — context decides (§66 obs. 3).

paradigms.label: παιδεύσων — Future Active Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: The present participle's endings on the future stem: 'about to / intending to educate'.

paradigms.label: παιδεύσων — Future Active Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Dative plural παιδεύσουσι(ν) spells the same as the future indicative 3rd plural — context decides.

paradigms.label: παιδεύσᾱς — First Aorist Active Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: Tense vowel -α- instead of the theme vowel: -σαντ- masculine/neuter, -σᾱσα feminine. No augment.

paradigms.label: παιδεύσᾱς — First Aorist Active Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Masculine/neuter dative plural: -αντσι(ν) → -ᾱσι(ν) (§48 sound change).

paradigms.label: λιπών — Second Aorist Active Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: The present participle's shape on the bare aorist stem λιπ-, with the accent thrown onto the endings.

paradigms.label: λιπών — Second Aorist Active Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Feminine genitive plural λιπουσῶν takes the circumflex ultima, like all short-α feminines.

paradigms.label: πεπαιδευκώς — Perfect Active Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: Declension stem -οτ- with NO ν; feminine -υῖα like γέφῡρα. 'Having (completed) educated.'

paradigms.label: πεπαιδευκώς — Perfect Active Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Masculine/neuter dative plural -οτσι → -οσι (§48); feminine genitive singular and accusative plural are homographs (-υίᾱς).

paradigms.label: παιδευόμενος — Present M/P Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: Theme vowel + -μενος, declined like a 2-1-2 adjective; masculine accusative and both neuter Nom/Acc are one form.

paradigms.label: παιδευόμενος — Present M/P Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Genitive plural παιδευομένων is one form for all three genders; the feminine keeps its acute (no circumflex ultima — §67 obs.).

paradigms.label: παιδευθείς — Aorist Passive Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: Principal Part VI's θ + -εντ-/-εισα: every verb forms this the same way (λειφθείς, λειφθεῖσα, λειφθέν).

paradigms.label: παιδευθείς — Aorist Passive Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Masculine/neuter dative plural -εντσι → -εισι (§48): παιδευθεῖσι(ν).

paradigms.label: παιδευσόμενος — Future Middle Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: 'About to educate for oneself.' Declines exactly like παιδευόμενος (§67).

paradigms.label: παιδευσόμενος — Future Middle Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Declines exactly like παιδευόμενος (§67).

paradigms.label: παιδευσάμενος — First Aorist Middle Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: Tense vowel -α- instead of the theme vowel; otherwise like παιδευόμενος. No augment.

paradigms.label: παιδευσάμενος — First Aorist Middle Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Declines exactly like παιδευόμενος (§67).

paradigms.label: λιπόμενος — Second Aorist Middle Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: The bare aorist stem λιπ- with the παιδευόμενος endings.

paradigms.label: λιπόμενος — Second Aorist Middle Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Declines exactly like παιδευόμενος (§67).

paradigms.label: πεπαιδευμένος — Perfect Middle/Passive Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: -μένος straight on the reduplicated stem, and the accent NEVER leaves -μέν-: the perfect participle's signature.

paradigms.label: πεπαιδευμένος — Perfect Middle/Passive Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Accent fixed on -μέν- in every cell.

paradigms.label: παιδευθησόμενος — Future Passive Participle (sg.)
paradigms.notes: Principal Part VI's θη + future σ + -μενος: 'about to be educated'.

paradigms.label: παιδευθησόμενος — Future Passive Participle (pl.)
paradigms.notes: Declines exactly like παιδευόμενος (§67).
